rule_owner: Trading System (research-only proposal to Research Lab)
data_source: existing published adjusted 1d chart with completed as-of session

parameters.volume_reference: current daily volume / 20 preceding completed sessions

precedence: TOUCH_ONLY or prior_close>pivot and close<=pivot => RECHECK
human_gate: Published Stage 2 parent must be READY, approved by identified manual reviewer at or before as-of NY-local date 23:59:59. The earliest research availability is max(16:00 NY, approval timestamp).
point_in_time_warning: Retrospective observations approved after the as-of session are INELIGIBLE as historical live signals. Historical pivot provenance requires further validation.
assumptions: No future OHLCV bars used in current as-of classification
No intraday bar ordering or trade/fill inference
RVOL 1.5x and 3% proximity are exploratory parameters, not official Qullamaggie rules
No realized return or forward performance metric asserted
Representative data must include delisted/unselected candidates to mitigate survivorship and selection bias
Human approval and frozen pivot must be reconstructed point-in-time before historical backtest
restrictions: Do not write to tracking_state.json or site/data/latest.json
Do not move WATCH to TRIGGERED or auto-trade
No strategy promotion without independent Research Lab validation and explicit owner approval
